official_posts.idea: Prelaunch: shopping receipts become stock tokens
official_posts.text:
Meet Crumbs, built on Robinhood Chain.

Shop at Costco, get $COST. Buy from Apple, get $AAPL.

Turn eligible receipts into stock-token rewards from the companies you already shop with.

Join us before launch: crumbs.family

The preview shows the lowercase dark-green crumbs wordmark against a soft mint-to-lime field, with a loading spinner; the displayed counter is 0:10. It likely introduces the receipt-to-stock concept using animated typography and brand identity; the full video was not watched.
Image: the dark-green crumbs wordmark and its pixel-fragment C on a white/mint mosaic background. It acts as a branded thread-ending signature.
